Genuine transparent alpha background, no scenery, floor, shadows, HUD, title, caption, watermark, duplicates, contact sheet or animation sheet. Mild upper-left light and restrained original-game palette. No invented equipment, extra limbs, anatomy, armor or effects. Fidelity target is the exact named source game, no crossover/remake features. Subject: Baby Voltigore from Half-Life Opposing Force original GoldSrc version. Preserve its reddish-brown soft carapace, squat heavy arched upper torso, broad flattened head with tiny teeth and dangling appendages, long paired front pincers, jointed pointed legs and tapering tail as shown. This is the juvenile reddish creature, not the adult purple armored Voltigore. Preserve the model's exact limb arrangement and its grounded low compact stance. No electricity and no spit.
